messages.subject: Site fencing availability
messages.body:
Hi,

We're going to need site fencing for an upcoming demolition job. We'd be looking at 50m runs. Can you check what you have available?

Thanks,
Mikko
Pohjois-Suomen Purkupalvelu Oy

messages.subject: Re: Site fencing availability
messages.body:
Hi Mikko,

Got your message. I'll check stock on the site fencing and come back to you with what we have.

When roughly would you need it, and for how long? That way I can confirm straight away.

Best regards,
Hanna-Kaisa Louhi
Rental Coordinator

messages.subject: Re: Site fencing availability
messages.body:
Hanna-Kaisa,

Separate thing while I'm at it. We got an invoice for the site cabin we had recently and the rental days on it don't look right. Could someone check it?

Mikko

messages.subject: Re: Site fencing availability
messages.body:
Hi Mikko,

I'll pull up the site cabin invoice and check the rental period for you. Will be in touch once I've had a look.

Regards,
Jussi Karna
Rental Coordinator

messages.subject: Re: Site fencing availability
messages.body:
The fencing can come back now, site is cleared. How do we arrange collection? Easiest if you pick up from site or do we need to bring it to the depot?

Mikko

messages.subject: Date change for mini dumper
messages.body:
Morning,

Need to shift the dates on our 1-tonne mini dumper booking. The schedule on site has moved so the original dates no longer work. Can you update it? I'll call if easier to sort over the phone.

Jarkko
Oulujoen Betonityö Oy

messages.subject: Excavator availability
messages.body:
Hello,

Could you let us know if you have a 13-tonne excavator available for hire? We have some groundwork coming up and would need it fairly soon.

Best regards,
Pasi
Teollisuuspalvelu Hautala Oy

messages.subject: 20kVA generator booking
messages.body:
We'd like to book the same 20kVA diesel generator we had last time. Same setup as before if possible. Let me know availability.

Mikko
Pohjois-Suomen Purkupalvelu Oy

messages.subject: Re: 20kVA generator booking
messages.body:
Thanks for sorting that.

Can we also get a 140L concrete mixer booked? Same as our previous rental for one. Let me know if you need anything from our end.

Mikko

messages.subject: Track loader return
messages.body:
Just a heads up, we're wrapping up with the compact track loader. Can you arrange collection or should we drop it at the depot ourselves?

Timo
Nostopalvelu Karjula Oy
